mechanics.claim: Soul Furnace grants a shield lasting up to 6 seconds and can be recast after 3 seconds while it holds, detonating automatically at the end of the duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Sion''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for up to 6 seconds. ''Soul Furnace'' can be recast after 3 seconds while the shield holds, and does so automatically at the end of the duration.

mechanics.claim: The recast damage is capped at 400 against minions and monsters.
Gaining or losing AP or health, or ranking up the skill while the shield is active does not change the shield's value but does change the detonation damage.
mechanics.quote: Gaining or losing AP or health, or ranking up the skill while the shield is active will not change its shield value but it will change the damage of the shield's detonation.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown of Soul Furnace begins only once the shield is removed.
mechanics.quote: The [[cooldown]] of ''Soul Furnace'' begins once the shield is removed.

mechanics.claim: Sion gains bonus health from any of his damage sources killing an enemy: 4 bonus health for normal kills, 15 for large enemies and champion takedowns.
mechanics.quote: '''Sion''' gains {{sti|health|{{as|4 '''bonus''' health}}}} whenever he kills an {{tt|enemy|see notes for details}}, increased to {{as|15|health}} for large enemies and {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champions}}.

mechanics.claim: Both of Soul Furnace's casts can be activated during Sion's other abilities.
mechanics.quote: Both of Soul Furnace's casts can be activated during '''Sion's''' other abilities.
